title: Onboarding-KB value: FLOOR 14% → CEILING 57% (no-repo isolation)
summary: When both cold+KB answer arms are denied repo access (empty cwd + `--tools ""` + no-access instruction), the KB is the only project-specific source. Fresh trustworthy reading: cold_rate_control=100% (validity intact), cold_rate_project=29% (down from 86% with repo access), kb_rate_project=86%, kb_earned_project=57% (4/7). So real onboarding-KB value brackets 14% (floor, cold had repo) → 57% (ceiling, no repo). The gap IS the value of code-reading: ~3/7 project probes are solvable by reading source, so KB earns its keep mainly when code-reading is unavailable/expensive. Recommend GO on learning loop /11 — KB carries real, judge-verified competence the cold agent cannot reconstruct without the repo.
